opening.argument: The video promotes a free Google Play gift card and directs viewers to an external website to obtain a code. Its walkthrough makes the promised reward depend on pressing claim, completing an “I am not a robot” verification, and then copying or redeeming a promotional code. The page visibly presents a VIEW CODES control, reinforcing that path from the offer to the code. This is a low-barrier reward pitch tied to an external site, even though the material does not establish any request for payment or private information. Nor does it show a successful redemption: the displayed result indicates that the entered code had already been redeemed.
